## Evidence details

### Nissan Skyline GT-R (BNR32)

- Queue ID: `fandom-family-0e07a7139454d2e8`
- Wiki evidence: [Hot Wheels Wiki contributors](https://hotwheels.fandom.com/wiki/Nissan_Skyline_GT-R_%28BNR32%29) — The main page maps HYY72 to the Jun Imai-designed 2019 tool, while a separate 2026 RLC page documents a structurally different opening-hood 1:64 tool under the same base display name.
- Independent evidence: [Hot Wheels Collectors News Catalog](https://catalog.hwcollectorsnews.com/SeriesDefinitions/Details/1905?aslist=true) — The variation catalog records HYY72 as a 2025 Nissan Skyline GT-R (BNR32) release under the exact name.
- Machine recommendation: `hold` at family scope; variant remains `hold`.
- Reviewer confirmation: **pending**
